_comment: Reviewed CodeQL false positives. Each entry suppresses exactly one rule in one file. Add a reason; never allowlist a real issue.

entries.reason: API keys are 256-bit random tokens (secrets.token_urlsafe(32)), not passwords. A fast SHA-256 digest is the lookup key shared with the Worker (worker/api_keys.mjs) and D1 api_keys.key_hash; a slow KDF adds nothing against brute force of 256-bit secrets.
Offline test script printing synthetic model predictions for sample messages; not shipped and contains no credentials.
